entry.name: Binh Thanh Nguyen
entry.university: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis
entry.department: Pollution Management Research Group, Energy, Climate, and Environment Program

evidence.currentRole: [IIASA personal staff page](https://iiasa.ac.at/staff/binh-nguyen), opened in this run — "Research Scholar/Software Engineer". Biography records employment since February 2008.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: [IIASA biography](https://iiasa.ac.at/staff/binh-nguyen) records a doctorate in data warehousing from the Technical University of Vienna, June 2001. Also coauthored the 2026 paper [Cost-effective mitigation strategies for air quality management in Uttar Pradesh, India](https://pure.iiasa.ac.at/id/eprint/21501/1/1-s2.0-S0301479726012442-main.pdf).
evidence.vietnameseSignal: [Employer biography](https://iiasa.ac.at/staff/binh-nguyen) gives the full name Binh Thanh Nguyen and previous teaching employment at Hue University, Vietnam.
evidence.location: [2026 paper, first page](https://pure.iiasa.ac.at/id/eprint/21501/1/1-s2.0-S0301479726012442-main.pdf) assigns Binh Nguyen to affiliation a, the same Pollution Management group as his staff biography — "Schlossplatz 1, Laxenburg, A-2361, Austria".
evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json for full name, reordered names and profile URL; ran npm run find-roster-matches for Binh Thanh Nguyen, Nguyen Thanh Binh and Binh Nguyen with the employer URL. No URL or exact full-name match. Compared fuzzy matches by discipline and education: particularly vp-0654 is an Ottawa radiologist, vp-1528 has a 2014 NUS doctorate, vp-3148 has a 2021 Macquarie doctorate, and vp-3342 is an organic chemist with a 2008 doctorate. Other matches concern different names, specialties or degrees. Checked already-proposed.txt; its Thanh Binh Nguyen lead is distinct from this IIASA researcher.

entry.name: Huong Thi Giang Tran
entry.department: Division of Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Control, Regional Office for the Western Pacific
entry.phdInstitution: National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology

evidence.currentRole: [WHO personal biography](https://www.who.int/westernpacific/about/governance/regional-director/speeches/huong-thi-giang-tran), opened in this run — "Director, Division of Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Control".
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: [Employer biography](https://www.who.int/westernpacific/about/governance/regional-director/speeches/huong-thi-giang-tran) records a PhD in Public Health from the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology, Viet Nam. Her ongoing research activity is also supported by the 2025 paper [Tuberculosis among foreign-born populations in the Western Pacific Region](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s41182-025-00866-7).
evidence.vietnameseSignal: [WHO biography](https://www.who.int/westernpacific/about/governance/regional-director/speeches/huong-thi-giang-tran) explicitly identifies her as Vietnamese and documents her previous leadership at Vietnam's Ministry of Health.
evidence.location: [2025 research paper, Authors and Affiliations](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s41182-025-00866-7) explicitly assigns Huong Thi Giang Tran to "World Health Organization Regional Office for the Western Pacific, Manila, Philippines" and identifies her as WHO staff.
evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json for Huong Thi Giang Tran, Tran Thi Giang Huong and the profile URL; ran npm run find-roster-matches with both name orders and the employer URL. No exact-name or URL match. Fuzzy hits vp-0164, vp-2098, vp-2145, vp-3118 and vp-3547 have different disciplines and doctoral institutions: information systems, mathematics, education or biotechnology. Checked already-proposed.txt; neither full-name form is listed.
